answer_1.quote: we propose a new framework for generating personalized, engaging headlines ... Our goal is to generate a user-engaging headline that conveys the main idea of a given news article d for a specific user u.

answer_2.quote: We use various metrics to evaluate the entire personalized headline generation pipeline: (1) Relevance Metrics... (2) Recommendation Score... (3) Factual Consistency... (4) Surface Overlap. We use ROUGE-L F1 and Extractive Coverage to evaluate the surface overlap between the generated headline and the reference headline/news article.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a two-step human evaluation using 16 evaluators who have high English proficiency... We evaluated the headlines from three perspectives: (1) User adaptation; (2) Headline appropriateness and (3) Text quality. The grading scale ranges from 1 (worst) to 3 (best), and detailed grading standards are provided in Appendix A.3.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators grade each generated headline on a 1‑3 scale for user adaptation, headline appropriateness, and text quality.
